text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — onboarding for atlas-30b-mqa is in smoke. weights landed at s3://rwd-models/atlas-30b/v1/weights.tar, config in repo under models/atlas-30b/model.yaml

Ravi: ACK. Pulled weights and ran tokenizer unit tests. hitting sporadic token splits at newline boundaries when sliding-window=1024.

Sam: Logs snippet: ```
WARN tokenizer: split_at_boundary: index 1024 (char '\n')
module: tokenizer/bytepair.cpp:line 198
ctx: input contains U+200B zero-width char near boundary
```

Maya: Can someone double-check RoPE scaling? On GQA runs attention scores blow up past 2k tokens. Might be rotary multiplier interacting with window-chunking.

Taylor: I instrumented the KV cache path. Looks like the relative-pos scaling is applied twice when the request crosses sliding windows (tiling path + concat path). Suspect a missing guard in attention.cc around apply_rotary_chunked().

Ravi: Repro command I used: `./serve --model atlas-30b --max-tokens 4096 --sliding-window 1024 --batch 1` — adding `--rope-scale=0.5` reduces the spike. Not a long-term fix.

Sam: Filed PR 4321 to add config lint rule: require explicit `rope_scale` and `gqa_mode` in model.yaml, and warn if sliding-window is enabled without tokenizer chunking rules. PTAL @Maya

Maya: LGTM on the lint but please add unit for input starting with U+200B (zero-width space). That was the trigger here.

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: infra/serve-atlas-30b-2026-03-16T15:20Z (job 9876)

Taylor: Quick question on fallback semantics — if MQA path errors during runtime, do we auto-fallback to a GQA-compatible variant with kv-tiling, or does that require policy flip?

Maya: For latency-sensitive routes we auto-fallback to the nearest-compatible variant (gqa-compat) with kv-tiling enabled. For dedicated routes we keep failures visible and require manual rollback. I'll update the rollout doc to make that explicit.

Ravi: I will run the full onboard checklist tonight and post the results here (tokenizer tests, attention e2e, kv-consistency). If anyone can review PR 4321 in the morning that'd be great.

Sam: Thanks — also quick ask: can someone run `pytest tests/tokenizer/test_sliding_window.py::test_newline_and_zero_width` in CI? flakey on Linux-GPU.

Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup: Will follow up with a short remediation checklist in the morning (disable canary if spike > 3x baseline, set rope_scale override, add tokenizer sanitization).

Taylor: Noted; I'll add an instrumentation dashboard panel for "rotary_scale_multiplier" and a tracer tag for crossing-window events.

Ravi: Cool. I'll ping once full run completes.

Sam: Appreciate it.
